title: The Dead Man Who Tricked Hitler
description:
A dead man fooled Hitler, and nobody knew his name for more than fifty years.
In 1943 British intelligence gave a body the identity of "Major William Martin", with a fiancée's photo, love letters and secret papers, and let it wash ashore in Spain. Germany believed the Allies would land in Greece and Sardinia; in July they landed in Sicily. The man was Glyndwr Michael, a homeless Welshman who died in London.

Sources: Wikipedia (Operation Mincemeat); History.co.uk; National WWII Museum; Britannica
